name: Mai
quote: Let the balloon soar, and our hopes along with it.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: I should start monitoring this morning's humidity and wind direction... Oh, good morning!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Oh, no. The screen on my observation equipment has been flashing non-stop since the sun headed west...

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Just close your eyes, and feel the evening breeze caressing your body...

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Hmm... My observation balloon is running out of battery. Then again, I have been using it all day...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Today's temperature, humidity, and air quality index are all looking good. How I wish it would be like this every day...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Aaahh! My balloon is getting blown away!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Perhaps not even a thunder strike could wake you up.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: I'm planning to do a weather exploration simulation on the sector's borders. Would you like to join me, Professor?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Do you need me for anything?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Excuse me, um... I'm working.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: P-please, not here Professor!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: I'll do the best I can.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: My name is Mai! If there is anything I can do to help, please let me know!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I have made more progress today.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I think I've improved a bit, but I am not good enough yet.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I still have a long way to go, but I believe in myself now. One day in the future, I'll become a Doll who can stand on her own two feet, I'm sure of it.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I am ready.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Everyone else is working so hard. I must also do my best!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: I'll give it all I've got!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: I did it!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: I won, but I shouldn't get ahead of myself...

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: No... Was it all for nothing...?

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I can't believe you would feel this way towards an insignificant Doll like me... It feels so unreal. I-I am... I am overjoyed! You feel the same, right, Professor?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Visiting a shrine on New Year's Day will bring us good luck for the rest of the year. Um, Professor, perhaps we could go together?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: I got you some chocolates, but they're not too expensive. The packaging is nothing fancy either, but they taste really good. Wait, this isn't chocolate? Aren't these soft candies? I got duped...

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Only on a clear night can you see this many stars in the sky. Professor, can you see the Milky Way over on the horizon?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Today's a special occasion, so I prepared a whole lot of candy! Once it gets darker, I'll tie them to the balloon and hand them out to the children.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor! Achoo... I-it's so cold!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Here, I prepared a birthday present for you, Professor! It's my favorite tea from my personal collection! It's not very expensive, but really tastes great.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Reprimanded yet again... Maybe I really am no good at my job. I can't even get data collection done properly. But I am not the kind of Doll to be frustrated at such a minor setback. I must work harder.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
There's no value in working hard unless you have a clear goal in mind.
Sometimes I don't know what I should do next, what are my goals... It's all quite vexing.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Thank you so much for always listening to me! Compared to everyone else in the Oasis, I'm so insignificant. 
That being said, even unexceptional Dolls like me have a burning desire to improve themselves.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
What do you think I should do, Professor?
I think... Oh, the data shows a storm is approaching soon. We should head back, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Professor, I think I've finally figured it out!
As we walk along the path we've set out for ourselves, we must not allow ourselves to be distracted by anything in our periphery. I must look straight ahead and focus on my own journey so that I can have a firm grasp on my ideal future. Hmm... Professor, I suppose you must have always done the same.

career:
The MAIA was developed by 42Lab, and is a scientific research Doll designed for meteorological monitoring and research. It is equipped with essential functions such as environmental data collection, analysis, and prediction and is responsible for assisting the scientific research team in completing research and testing work. 

To meet their profession's requirements, 42Lab upgraded MAIA's environmental adaptation systems, increasing MAIA's outdoor resistances and its ability to handle extreme weather.

Mai was awoken comparatively late and she lacks work experience compared to similar Dolls, but her brilliant execution and enthusiasm for work have been recognized by members of the science team. Therefore, when Project Neural Cloud started, the institute decided to add her to the recommendations list.
infoStories:
Monday, April 2nd. Weather: Clear. Wind: Easterly 2.

Today was my first day in the field... but it seems like I messed up...

I didn't properly calibrate the instruments before setting off, and only discovered the problem when I started the test...

Fortunately, it was just a small test, but I must be better next time!

I can do this! I won't be a liability!

Saturday, July 7th. Weather: Thunderstorm. Wind: South Easterly 5.

It was really coming down today! We had to hide in the temporary camp.

But... I did so love the rain. Sitting by the tent door, listening to the pitter-patter of the water falling on the grass... wouldn't it be great if we could also have some hot tea and snacks?

So I asked the instructor if she had any snacks, but she said she only brought compressed biscuits.

Ahh, but biting into this brick would knock all my teeth out, right?

We had some spare time, so the instructor taught me some important camping skills. When I go out with the exploration team in the future, I'll be able to help!

Friday, November 16th. Weather: Overcast. Wind: North Westerly 7.

Wow, what strong winds! It actually blew all the huts into the sky...! But even scarier than the wind were the guys from the laboratory. They even asked me, won't I also be blown out into the sky if I wear this monitoring balloon every day? Could it be they don't know how heavy a Doll is?

...Eh? Wait a second. Is this what the instructor mentioned earlier? "Special measures to deal with extreme weather"? It couldn't be that I'm the only heavy one out of all the 42Lab Dolls? Eh? Eh? No, it can't be, I have to ask Max and the others and get to the bottom of this!

(Added November 17th: Wahhhhh... it was true after all!)

Monday, December 24th. Weather: Light Snow. Wind: North Westerly 2.

I just handed in the last batch of monitoring records, and I will return to the laboratory this afternoon to prepare for Project Neural Cloud testing.

Does being in the first batch of subjects mean that the researchers acknowledged me? To be honest, when I first heard the news all those weeks ago, I was so excited I almost cried on the spot... but then I thought about everyone working hard over the holidays... I can't fall behind.

There's been no snow all winter. I never would have imagined it was waiting for the perfect time. The flakes started falling today, Christmas Eve. It's so beautiful.

?????, ??/??/????. Weather: ? (Weather Monitor Failed to Acquire Valid Data)

How much time has passed...?

I heard the others saying that we've been sleeping in the cloud for a long time. How is the real world doing? I should have left more weather records... if I'm away, then everyone at the institute must be so busy. In the end, I've left them with more problems...

Ahh, it's no good to think like this. At least, with the Professor's help, I've found my place among the Exiles. I also need to start studying for the duties I'm responsible for.

I shall pull through all kinds of difficulties! You can do it, Mai!
oathDesc: The weather in other's hearts might be gloomy and unpredictable, but her's seems to be always sunny.

"It's going to be a beautiful day. Let's go for a walk! —Ah, don't forget the weather monitoring balloon!"

"This is a good spot for weather observation. Shall we go together?"

skinList.name: Warm Breeze
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection—"Temperature sensing-systems, activated; humidity and illumination sensors, activated... Um, h-hello! I'm Mai! I'm a meteorologist, and this is my first time reporting here... Ehhhh, where'd my balloon go?"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
We shall be written into a landscape of 0s and 1s, a deviation in system workings, a ripple in neural cycles, a piece of memory that shall never be wiped away.
""These are a few things Mai has prepared for you, Professor. Take it, please...""
